name: pam_pkcs11
detailed_description: X.509 certificate-based user login module. Allows users to authenticate using PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) smart cards, USB tokens, or other PKCS#11 compatible devices. Provides strong cryptographic authentication.
notes:
Requires smartcard reader and certificates properly configured. Recommended for high-security environments.
